title: SPIRAL: Learning to Search and Aggregate
abstract: arXiv:2606.23595v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language model reasoning can be substantially improved at test time via scaffolds that scale inference compute across different primitives -- sequential reasoning within a trace, independently sampled parallel traces, and aggregation of multiple reasoning traces into a final response. During post-training, however, language models are optimized only for sequential reasoning within a single trace. We introduce Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning (SPIRAL), a framework in which a language model is trained to use all three primitives, as part of a unified inference compute pipeline. Concretely, the language model first samples a set of independent traces in parallel, each produced through sequential chain-of-thought reasoning, and then generates a final aggregation trace conditioned on those traces; all components are optimized end-to-end against the reward of the final aggregated response. translated_abstract: 语言模型的推理能力可以在测试时通过在不同基元上扩展推理计算量的脚手架得到显著提升——这些基元包括单条推理轨迹内的顺序推理、独立采样的并行轨迹，以及将多条推理轨迹聚合成最终回答。然而，在后训练阶段，语言模型仅针对单条轨迹内的顺序推理进行优化。我们提出了顺序-并行-聚合强化学习（SPIRAL），这是一个训练语言模型使用全部三种基元的框架，将其作为统一推理计算流水线的一部分。具体而言，语言模型首先并行采样一组独立轨迹，每条轨迹通过顺序的思维链推理生成，然后基于这些轨迹生成最终的聚合轨迹；所有组件均以最终聚合回答的奖励为目标进行端到端优化。为训练该系统，SPIRAL
tldr: 提出SPIRAL强化学习框架，端到端训练语言模型在统一的推理计算流水线中同时掌握顺序推理、并行采样和轨迹聚合三种基元，以提升推理能力。
en_tdlr: SPIRAL is a reinforcement learning framework that end-to-end trains language models to jointly leverage sequential reasoning, parallel trace sampling, and aggregation within a unified inference compute pipeline.
